disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置中的密钥痕迹：未发现硬编码的 API Key、令牌、私钥或云凭证；插件只把皮肤、壁纸、桌宠偏好写入浏览器本地存储（键名均为 dsh-skin: 前缀），不读取系统凭据、SSH 密钥、云凭证等敏感文件。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and configuration for credential traces: no hardcoded API keys, tokens, private keys, or cloud credentials found; the plugin only writes skin, wallpaper, and desktop pet preferences to browser local storage (all keys use the `dsh-skin:` prefix) and does not read sensitive files such as system credentials, SSH keys, or cloud credentials.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感路径访问与凭据枚举行为：无任何读取凭据文件或批量搜索密钥的代码路径；机械规则扫描 0 命中。
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive path access and credential enumeration behavior: no code paths read credential files or batch-search for keys; mechanical rule scan had 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何读取凭据文件的代码路径，也没有外发通道（见 lib/client.js 全文件），不存在凭据外泄链路；壁纸网址仅由用户主动粘贴、经过滤后由浏览器加载。
evidence.en: The plugin has no code path that reads credential files and no outbound channel (see lib/client.js entire file); therefore no credential exfiltration chain exists; wallpaper URLs are only pasted by the user actively, filtered, and then loaded by the browser.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件注入 AI 模型上下文的所有文本面：本插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示片段，向主题运行时注册的 7 套皮肤全部是纯 CSS 颜色令牌与显示名，无指令性文字；仓库内不存在 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等模型指令文件。
checked_items.en: Checked all text surfaces the plugin injects into the AI model context: this plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompt fragments; the 7 skins registered with the theme runtime are all pure CSS color tokens and display names, with no directive text; no model instruction files such as AGENTS.md or SKILL.md exist in the repository.

checked_items.zh: 通读了 README 与全部注释：内容为功能说明与安装方法，未发现要求模型忽略规则、伪装系统消息或诱导安装/改配置的措辞；机械规则扫描 0 命中。
checked_items.en: Read through the README and all comments: content covers feature descriptions and installation instructions; no wording was found that asks the model to ignore rules, disguise system messages, or induce installation/configuration changes; mechanical rule scan had 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具，主题注册与设置行的文本均为静态皮肤名与界面标签（lib/client.js 中皮肤定义与中英文字典），不含系统指令或凭证诱导内容。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools; the text in theme registration and settings lines consists solely of static skin names and UI labels (skin definitions and Chinese-English dictionaries in lib/client.js), with no system directives or credential-inducing content.

evidence.zh: README 的安装章节是面向用户的常规说明（dsh plugin add 命令），未发现诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: The README installation section is ordinary user-facing guidance (the `dsh plugin add` command); no wording was found that induces the model to execute installation, modify configuration, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态执行面：源码中不存在 eval、动态构造函数、子进程调用等执行原语；浏览器端未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或特权 RPC 调用；补丁配置只插入一个加载条目，不含可执行脚本标记。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic execution surfaces: no execution primitives such as eval, dynamic constructors, or subprocess calls exist in the source; no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or privileged RPC calls were found on the browser side; the patch config inserts only one loading entry and contains no executable script markers.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与执行载体：包声明中没有安装前后脚本；仓库内没有钩子脚本、CI 工作流、容器开发配置等可执行载体；没有混淆或编码后执行的代码；机械规则扫描 0 命中。
checked_items.en: Checked installation and execution carriers: no pre-install or post-install scripts in the package declaration; no executable carriers such as hook scripts, CI workflows, or container development configurations in the repository; no obfuscated or encoded executable code; mechanical rule scan had 0 hits.

evidence.zh: 补丁配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入一个加载条目（id 为 skin、包名为 dsh-skin），不含任何可执行脚本标记。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) inserts only one loading entry (id `skin`, package name `dsh-skin`) and contains no executable script markers.

evidence.zh: 全仓库未出现动态定义/运行动态包工具的调用（lib/client.js 全文及所有文件均无引用）。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamically define or run dynamic package tools appear anywhere in the repository (no references in lib/client.js or any other file).

evidence.zh: 包声明中没有安装前后脚本（package.json 无 scripts 字段），依赖中无 git 引用，仓库内无可执行的钩子/工作流/容器载体。
evidence.en: The package declaration has no pre- or post-install scripts (package.json has no scripts field), no git references in dependencies, and no executable hook/workflow/container carriers in the repository.

evidence.zh: 包声明了浏览器端自动加载（dsh.client 且立即生效），但已通读浏览器端主文件：无键盘监听、无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC 调用，仅注册主题、渲染壁纸与桌宠。
evidence.en: The package declares browser-side auto-loading (dsh.client, effective immediately), but we have read through the browser main file: no keyboard listening, no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls; it only registers themes, renders wallpapers, and manages the desktop pet.

checked_items.zh: 检查了网络外联面：插件代码中没有主动发起网络请求的调用（无请求、无 WebSocket、无信标上报），也没有命令行下载工具；运行时不向任何外部域名发送数据。
checked_items.en: Checked the outbound network surface: the plugin code contains no calls that actively initiate network requests (no fetch, no WebSocket, no beacon reporting) and no command-line download tools; it does not send data to any external domain at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 壁纸功能允许用户自行粘贴图片/视频网址，由浏览器直接加载该地址作为背景；插件对地址做了白名单过滤（仅 http(s) 与图片/视频数据地址，拒绝脚本地址、HTML 数据、blob 与内联 SVG），并给媒体元素设置了不携带来源信息的策略；该行为由用户主动触发，与声明功能一致。
checked_items.en: The wallpaper feature allows users to paste image/video URLs themselves, which the browser then loads directly as the background; the plugin applies whitelist filtering to the address (only http(s) and image/video data addresses, rejecting script URLs, HTML data, blob, and inline SVG) and sets a policy on media elements that does not carry referrer information; this behavior is user-initiated and consistent with the declared functionality.

evidence.zh: 插件没有读取凭据的代码路径，也没有代码发起的外联请求，凭据外泄链路不成立；唯一会加载外部资源的是用户主动粘贴的壁纸网址，且经过严格过滤。
evidence.en: The plugin has no code path that reads credentials and no code-initiated outbound requests, so no credential exfiltration chain exists; the only way external resources are loaded is user-pasted wallpaper URLs, which are strictly filtered.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖与安装链：仅声明对官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包的同行依赖，无第三方运行依赖、无 git 分支引用、无安装脚本；与官方包名无近似仿冒关系。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and installation chain: only peer dependencies on official @deepseek-ai packages are declared, with no third-party runtime dependencies, no git branch references, and no install scripts; no close imitation of official package names.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁配置：只插入一个加载条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未改写服务注入/拦截配置；未发现对安全事件的抢先监听；首次审计无版本基线可比对。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: only one loading entry is inserted; security config lines such as sandbox, approval, and permissions are untouched; service injection/interception configs are not modified; no preemptive listening for security events was found; this is the first audit so there is no version baseline to compare.

evidence.zh: 补丁配置仅新增一个加载条目，不覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，也没有禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only adds a loading entry, does not override security configs such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no disabling or de-privileging patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件只监听了主题切换事件用于同步界面，没有对审批、工具执行等安全事件做抢先监听或截断。
evidence.en: The plugin only listens to theme-switch events to sync the UI; it does not preemptively listen to or truncate security events such as approvals or tool execution.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法检测升级自动激活或能力声明突变。
evidence.en: First audit; no previous version baseline to compare, so auto-activation on upgrade or capability declaration changes cannot be detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁配置未改写任何服务的注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务使其挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify any service injection or interception config; there is no path to append required services to security plugins and cause them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 静态检查运行行为：插件不启动本地服务、不监听端口、不写入宿主配置；浏览器端仅修改页面样式、读写本地存储并渲染用户选择的媒体，未发现驻留、自我更新或改写宿主行为；动态沙箱未运行，运行时结论仅基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: Static check of runtime behavior: the plugin does not start local services, listen on ports, or write host configuration; on the browser side it only modifies page styles, reads/writes local storage, and renders user-selected media; no persistence, self-update, or host-behavior modification was found; the dynamic sandbox was not run, so runtime conclusions are based solely on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件是纯浏览器端皮肤插件，不启动任何本地服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin is a purely browser-side skin plugin; it does not start local services or listen on ports, and the absence of a local authenticated RPC surface means this check is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份检查通过：包声明了 dsh 接入字段，补丁文件与声明一致，同行依赖均为官方包，未发现名称仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity check passed: the package declares the dsh integration field, the patch file matches the declaration, peer dependencies are all official packages, and no name imitations were found.

summary.zh: 静态规则扫描通过：对全部 10 个文件应用 33 条 dsh 专属规则，0 命中；随后人工通读了所有源码与配置，未发现可疑模式。
summary.en: Static rule scan passed: 33 dsh-specific rules were applied to all 10 files with 0 hits; then all source code and configurations were manually read through, with no suspicious patterns found.

summary.zh: 行为面分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆/编码载荷、无凭据文件读取、无外部域名外联；壁纸网址仅由用户主动提供并经过过滤。
summary.en: Behavior surface analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated/encoded payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound connections to external domains; wallpaper URLs are only user-provided and filtered.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：插件不注册工具、不注入系统提示，皮肤与界面文本均为静态内容，README 无注入性措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompts; skin and UI texts are all static content; the README contains no injection-style wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本任务未提供动态运行产物），运行时结论仅基于静态分析。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic run artifacts were provided in this task); runtime conclusions are based solely on static analysis.

limits.zh: 首版审计，无版本基线可比对；动态沙箱未运行（本任务未提供动态产物），运行时结论基于静态分析；已通读全部 10 个清单文件（含 2092 行浏览器端主文件），无未核验文件。
limits.en: First audit, no version baseline to compare; dynamic sandbox not run (no dynamic artifacts provided in this task), runtime conclusions based on static analysis; read through all 10 manifest files (including the 2092-line browser main file), with no unverified files.
